workout.warmup: 8-10 min incline walk (3.3-3.5 mph, 6-8%) - this is your back warmup on lower day, not optional. Bodyweight squats x 15 and leg swings. Ramp the squat: bar x 8, 135 x 5, 185 x 3, then work at 205.
workout.finisher: Skip if you're at 65 min. Otherwise 10-12 min incline walk.
workout.coach_note: Both heavy lifts move up today. Jul 30 you did 185 for 6/6/6 then put 10/side on and got 6 at 205 - so 205 is already proven for a set, today it's proven for four. The RDL went even better: you started 20 lb over what I wrote and took 205 for a clean 4x6, so 215 is the honest next step. Straps on, no exceptions. Two things carried over from the upper-day review: log PLATES PER SIDE and name the gym, because the Smith bar changes under you between locations and the totals stop meaning anything. And do the core this time - you skipped it Jul 30 and squats plus RDLs cover flexion and extension but nothing anti-rotation. If you're training tomorrow instead of today, this all still stands.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat [HEAVY]
exercises.note: You closed Jul 30 with 205 x 6 on set 4 after three sets at 185, so you already know this weight moves. Today it's all four sets. Below parallel, same depth you've been hitting. If set 3 drops under 6, take set 4 at 185 and finish strong rather than grinding. If the Smith is taken, sub Leg Press 360-390 for 4 x 6-8 and we flip the rotation next time.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift [HEAVY]
exercises.detail: 215 lb / 95 per side - 4 x 6 - STRAPS ON
exercises.note: Ramp 165 x 6, then 215 for four sets. You took 205 for a clean 4x6 unprompted last time and the hamstrings did the work, so this is an earned 10 lb, not a reach. Straps are mandatory - they're what solved the grip and kept the load off your upper back. Hinge from the hips, soft knee, bar close to the legs the whole way.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.note: HOLD at 70. You got 12/10/10 last time - the fade on sets 2 and 3 is the whole reason we're not adding weight. Get all three sets to 12 before we touch 75. Slow on the way back down, that eccentric is where hamstrings actually grow. Lying leg curl or stability-ball curls if the seated machine is taken.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust Machine
exercises.note: Second attempt - you subbed lunges last time when the machine was occupied, which was the right call. Glutes have been the missing piece of this block, so take the machine if it's free. Plate-loaded, 10 lb increments only. Full extension, hard squeeze, no hyperextension at the top. Fallback stays DB walking lunge 35 lb x 3 x 10/leg.

exercises.name: Core Circuit
exercises.detail: 2 rounds: Dead Bugs x 10/side, Side Plank 30 sec/side, Stability Ball Rollout x 10
exercises.note: Rotated off Sunday's pallof / knee raise / shoulder tap. All back-safe after two heavy hinge-pattern lifts. Ball rollout instead of ab wheel since you've used the ball before at these gyms - only roll as far as your lower back stays neutral. Don't skip it this time.

exercises.name: OPTIONAL - Free Barbell Squat (pattern work only)
exercises.note: ONLY if the gym has a rack and you're under 65 min. This is NOT a working set - it's cheap practice so the October transition isn't starting from zero. Your free bench transferred beautifully, but squatting free is a genuinely different skill: the Smith lets you lean into a fixed path, a free bar makes you balance and brace. Safety pins set just below depth, every set. Two easy sets, then walk away. Resist adding weight.
